title: Verify coupon-related REST API endpoints
body: The CreateCouponModal and CouponUsageModal were updated to use /api/coupons and /api/coupon-usages instead of /api/collections/coupons and /api/collections/coupon-usages. These changes should be verified to ensure the coupons functionality works correctly after the URL fix.
rationale: The coupons widgets were using the same incorrect /api/collections/ prefix pattern. While the fix follows the same logic as the transactions fix, these endpoints weren't specifically tested.
